column2: Let's hurry back to the great hall!
All right! Now I can move! Mazinger, GO!!
This time I'm gonna finish you off!
The moon!? So it's finally come out...
...I'm sorry, {p}... I understand what the Demon King is thinking. I accepted him!
You saw Kanto after the Hellquake too! In Jack's world, that's reality! Jiro Shutendo-kun is fated to go back to the Kigoku World! Shusha-kun's world will be destroyed when Susano-oh appears!
Is that... true?
It's because it's true that he's trying to remake the world! A world where nobody suffers, with no hatred or anger!
Before he can remake it, he has to destroy everything! What happens to the people living in the worlds he destroys!?
I don't know!\n\nThat's none of my business!
{s}! The Demon King is wrong!!
Ahh...
Ahh...\n\nIt's too late now, {p}...
It's not too late!
IT IS TOO LATE!!
The "Moon of destruction" is already within me! You will come too, "Sun of rebirth"...
There is still time before the eclipse.\n\nBefore the black sun comes, I shall devour you. And as the eclipse arrives, I shall watch from atop this hill as the world crumbles...!!
S-stay back!
Guhahahahaha...!\n\nRun if you can!
Stay baaack!
{p}-kun!
Honey!
It's okay! Everyone's safe!
Oho, how amusing! A little entertainment before the eclipse! Heroes of dying worlds, I shall play with you!!
Are you ready!?\n\nHeroes of dying worlds, I shall play with you!
GWAAAH!!
{s}! Hang in there!
Hang in there!
...Uhh... nnn...
Thank goodness, she's alive!
{p}...\n\n...The time... has come.
The eclipse... is starting...!! The black sun... is appearing...!!

{p}!

They vanished...

With the Demon King gone, did they go back to their own world...?

{p}!

They vanished...

With the Demon King down, did they make it back to their own world...?
Where is this...?\n\n{s}? ...She passed out.
We should be back in our own world... but maybe not? In Mondo-san's world, a huge earthquake turned Kanto into Hell...
Could it be... a huge earthquake happened in our world too...
A black moon!? No, a black sun!?
Fool...
Did you think I would be defeated so easily?
Ngh!

The eclipse has begun and my power has reached its peak. Until the eclipse ends, my power will hold. Your friends are nothing much, but they're like flies buzzing around the dinner table... I merely changed tables so I could devour you without interruption!
Be a good boy and be eaten!\n\nThe "Moon of destruction" awaits you inside me! Ahahahahaha!
Honey!
You! How did you get here!
{p}-kun, you're safe now!
Honey, how on earth did you get here?
Shinichi Kuruma-kun foresaw where you'd gone. And Shingo Shusha-kun teleported me there!
So this isn't our own world after all!
It's a patchwork world the Demon King made! Now, Demon King! This sword of Cutie Honey will cut your ambitions to pieces!
We should be back in our own world... but maybe not? In Takuma-kun's world, a huge earthquake turned Kanto into Hell...

Guaaargh...!

So close... I was so close... Grrr... Curse you...! But never forget! This is not the end...!!

GUAAAAAAAAH!!!!
Shinichi-kun! You saved us!
If you want to thank someone, it's not me. It's Maria.
That's right! Thank you, Maria-san!
Shusha-kun! Thanks for teleporting everyone!
I'm not Susano-oh anymore, I'm the hero king, the true god. Of course I'll use my power for the world and my friends!
I just lost Natsu-chan too... I know exactly how you feel, {p}-kun...
...I'm sorry, Honey.
It's okay.
Maria's voice told me something. The Demon King is dead, but the eclipse goes on.\n\nShe says that's proof the Dimension Chain is falling apart...
All of us can go back to our own worlds!
From the patchwork world the Demon King made?
That's right. And there, our true fates are waiting for us. The patched-together worlds have started to set themselves right!
But... even if it's our true fate, Natsu-chan is...
...She might be alive, you know.
Really!?
Yeah. Maria's voice echoing inside me keeps getting louder and louder. It's like Maria is calling me, right in my ear...!!
Then maybe, when we get back to our own world...!
Maybe you'll see {s}...!
Tomisaburo!
Yo-ho!
We're going home! Maria's waiting...!
Yahooo!!
Shinichi-kun! Thank you!
Looks like it's his turn to go home now.\n\nGo say a proper goodbye.
Looks like it's his turn next. Go say your goodbyes first.
Looks like my turn has come.
Shusha-kun...
Back in my world, will I become Susano-oh, or the hero king, the true god? Nobody knows.\n\nBut it'll be fine. I've got Yukishiro-san...
I've no wish to change the world anymore. So there's nothing to worry about, Shusha.
I hope that's true. You know, we're actually childhood friends!
Whoa! I never knew that!
When we were little, we even took baths together!
Hey, what are you saying!!
I'm glad we could say goodbye with a laugh, Shusha-kun...
Looks like it's our turn now.
Come visit the Photon Power Lab sometime, ya hear!
I wonder if there's a Photon Power Lab in your world too, {p}-kun?
If there's a Photon Power Lab, I'll give you a ride in Mazinger Z!
Yeah! I'd love that!!
And you've gotta try my special croquettes too!
Croquettes?
